pairs: The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
The Lord is avenging with his enemies,
and he becomes angry with his adversaries.
The Lord is patient and great in strength,
and those who are not clean,
The Lord is in a tempest,
and his way is a whirlwind,
and the clouds are dust at his feet.
He is the one who rebukes the sea,
et omnia flumina ad desertum deducens.
and who leads all the rivers to the desert.
and the flower of Lebanon has languished.
The mountains have trembled before him,
and the hills have become desolate,
et contremuit terra a facie ejus,
and the earth has quaked before his face,
and all that dwells in it.
Ante faciem indignationis ejus quis stabit?
Who can stand firm before the face of his indignation?
et quis resistet in ira furoris ejus?
And who can continue against the fury of his wrath?
Indignatio ejus effusa est ut ignis,
His indignation has broken out like a fire,
et petræ dissolutæ sunt ab eo.
and the rocks have been dissolved before him.
and a comforter in the day of tribulation,
and he knows those who hope in him.
Et in diluvio prætereunte consummationem faciet loci ejus,
And in the flood that passes over, he brings to consummation the end of his place.
And darkness shall pursue his adversaries.
What are you thinking up against the Lord?
There shall not rise up a double tribulation.
quia sicut spinæ se invicem complectuntur,
For just as thorns entwine one another, so also,
while they are feasting and drinking together,
they will be consumed like stubble that is completely dry.
Ex te exibit cogitans contra Dominum malitiam,
Out of you will go forth one who thinks up evil against the Lord,
yet still they would be pruned,
and it will cross through them.
and I shall afflict you no more.
Et nunc conteram virgam ejus de dorso tuo,
And now I will shatter his rod from your back,
and I will break open your bonds.
And the Lord will place a commandment over you;
non seminabitur ex nomine tuo amplius:
nothing more from your name will be sown.
de domo Dei tui interficiam sculptile,
From the house of your God,
I will order destroyed the graven image and the molten image.
the feet of the Evangelizer and the Announcer of peace.
festivitates tuas, et redde vota tua,
celebrate your festivals and keep your vows.
quia non adjiciet ultra ut pertranseat in te Belial: universus interiit.
For Belial will never again pass through you; he has completely passed away.
